concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 require epoching data into 'standard' and 'deviant' conditions (-200ms to 600ms). Task T018 is marked as unchecked/failed and is the ONLY task covering this requirement. Without T018, US-1 cannot produce the required 'epo_raw.fif' artifact, blocking US-2 and US-3.

FR-004 and US-2 require calculating peak amplitude/latency for 'standard' and 'deviant' conditions separately (before difference wave). T022 (load/average ERPs) and T027 (generate metrics.csv) are unchecked. T023/T024 only cover the difference wave logic. Missing T022/T027 means the 'standard_amplitude' and 'deviant_amplitude' columns in metrics.csv cannot be generated.

US-3 and SC-001/SC-005 require filtering participants based on 'peak_detected' flags and calculating prevalence. T029 (filter logic) and T039 (calculate prevalence) are unchecked. T035 (generate statistics.json) is marked '[~]' (incomplete) and depends on these missing steps.

FR-005, FR-007, and US-3 require generating 'results/statistics.json' and saving visualizations to 'results/plots/'. T035 and T038 are marked '[~]' (incomplete) and lack explicit completion status, leaving the final deliverables for US-3 unimplemented.
Plan Phase 1 and Constitution Principle III require 'data/raw' and 'data/processed' directory structures. T001 and T004 are unchecked, leaving the foundational data hygiene structure unimplemented.
US-1 Independent Test requires an integration test verifying 'epo_raw.fif' exists. T011 is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and unchecked, meaning the verification step for US-1 is missing.
US-2 Independent Test requires an integration test verifying 'results/metrics.csv' exists. T050 is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and unchecked, leaving US-2 unverified.
US-3 requires unit tests for FDR correction and integration tests for visualization. T051 and T052 are unchecked, leaving US-3 unverified.

T012 references 'FR-001' but the tag format is inconsistent with the rest of the document (e.g., T015 uses '[US1]'). While the description covers the requirement, the tagging is non-standard and may break automated traceability tools.

T032 references 'Plan Phase 3' and 'Constitution Principle VII' in the description but lacks a specific tag like '[SC-003]' or '[FR-005]' to explicitly link the mixed-effects model requirement to the spec's success criteria.
